meta.name: langchain
meta.description: Framework for building LLM-powered applications with agents, chains, and RAG. Supports multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), 500+ integrations, ReAct agents, tool calling, memory management, and vector store retrieval. Use for building chatbots, question-answering systems, autonomous agents, or RAG applications. Best for rapid prototyping and production deployments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用链式调用和智能体快速构建大模型应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用大模型构建聊天、问答或自动化智能体应用
copy.tagline_en: Build LLM-powered apps with chains, agents, and RAG
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building chatbots, Q&A systems, or autonomous agents with LLMs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你的需求生成使用LangChain代码来构建LLM应用，如创建带工具调用的代理（ReAct模式）、实现RAG管道、添加对话记忆等。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude用Python编写或解释LLM应用，特别是需要集成多个模型、工具或检索时触发。

say.text: 用LangChain创建一个连接搜索和天气工具的代理
say.note: Claude会生成创建代理的代码，并说明如何使用。

say.text: 帮我写一个基于RAG的问答系统，能从网页加载文档并回答用户问题

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate LangChain code to build LLM-powered applications such as agents with tool calling, RAG pipelines, and conversational memory.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to write or explain Python code for LLM applications, especially involving multiple providers, tools, or retrieval.

say_en.text: Use LangChain to create an agent with search and weather tools.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code and explain usage.

say_en.text: Write a RAG-based Q&A system that loads web documents and answers questions.
say_en.note: Claude will provide full code example.
